analysis: Reviewed both units of docs/developer/test.md (head text, lines 1312-2221). The changes are documentation only: test commands and qualification notes covering the Flash-next cache manifest/planner/scope fixtures, App Attest provider session reliability tests (worker transport, origin-bound replies, lifecycle), and cache attempt ownership during model replacement. The remainder is coordinator test layout, DB isolation, OpenRouter conformance, prompt-sidecar preload and MiMo fixtures. No production code, auth, encryption, billing or trust-policy behavior changes in these units. The text explicitly disclaims treating transport or fixture passes as serving qualification or as Apple acceptance, which is consistent with TB-011/T-052/T-053/T-054. The cache-scope fixture compares two synthetic accounts with identical caller cache labels, consistent with T-041's account-scoped cacheSalt (caller prompt_cache_key ignored). The guidance to run store tests only against disposable DBs, with per-process isolated databases, matches the existing safeguards. The command that drops its isolated DB uses an admin connection but does not touch the configured DB. No new attack surface, invalidated assumptions, or threat-model gaps found in the supplied lines. Coverage limit: only the head text of these two excerpts was supplied (no patch hunks), so which lines changed is unknown. Referenced tests and docs (app-attest-shadow.md, nativequalification README) were not visible, so their claims were not verified.
